reasoning_traces.think:
Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) abstract high-level features through hierarchical filters, enabling invariant object recognition despite affine transformations. However, CNNs struggle with long-range dependencies and require vast annotated datasets. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) like LSTMs address temporal coherence but suffer from gradient vanishing/explosion. Deep Sort integrates appearance descriptors with motion priors, providing robust tracking but introducing computational overhead. These primitives form a compositional pipeline: detection anchors trajectories, trajectories feed action classifiers, and classifiers update strategic assessments. Yet, adversarial occlusions and lighting changes create failure cascades. To mitigate, we employ ensemble predictions across multiple architectures and incorporate meta-learning to adapt to unseen game scenarios.
